pitches.name: Sofia
pitches.why: It's a farm animal that isn't eaten, so it fits the vegetarian café, and the owner used to keep one, which makes it personal. Its long ears make it instantly recognisable and cheerful in a window.

pitches.name: Omar
pitches.why: The client wants something small, friendly and cheerful that everyone recognises instantly, and a chick fits a farm café window perfectly. Its round body, beak and little feet are simple to read in dominoes and look cute.

pitches.name: Hana
pitches.why: The client's own hens wander among the café tables and the kids love them, so it's a personal, cheerful pick that suits a farm café. A chicken's silhouette (comb, beak, round body, tail) is also instantly recognisable to blind judges.

pitches.name: Jack
pitches.why: The café is on a farm and famous for its eggs and egg custard tarts, so a chicken ties directly to the brand, and it's cheerful and instantly recognisable even in domino form.
